ALGORITHM.gradient_diagnostic: one un-clipped, pre-optimizer-step backward per domain; no optimizer.step

PART_A_ALL_HISTORY_GEOMETRIC_COVERAGE_OR.observation_transform: 2*x-1 in float32; Euclidean L2 accumulated in float64
PART_A_ALL_HISTORY_GEOMETRIC_COVERAGE_OR.within_episode_nn_definition: nearest other observation in same episode; self-distance excluded

classification_evidence.rule: MATERIAL requires positive median/mean/P90 reductions for both E5/E6, at least 5% for each measure in both targets, and increased 2x overlap counts in both; otherwise WEAK. This is a multi-metric judgment, not a single 6-8% cutoff.

PART_A_ALL_HISTORY_GEOMETRIC_COVERAGE_OR.E3_E4_recent3_equals_allhistory_note: E3/E4 Recent3 pools equal AllHistory pools by construction and are descriptive only; incremental gain classification uses E5/E6.

decision_rule.strong: YES if >=4 of 6 history-current pair cosines are below -0.3 and at least 2 degraded contexts contain such a negative pair, or if >=2 contexts have raw history-current cosine < -0.3 and the corresponding A0.10 current or next Corr delta is negative
decision_rule.partial: PARTIAL if any pairwise or history-current cosine is negative but strong rule does not hold
decision_rule.no: NO if no negative pairwise/history-current cosine is observed
decision_rule.scale_domination: YES if raw history mean cosine is negative but direction-balanced history cosine is positive in any context
